$sqlComment: Shared SQL fixtures. Both SQL builders run these and must agree character for character. name/document/options/expectedSql, plus optional expectedParams, expectSkipped and expectThrows.

sqlCases.name: empty document is 1 = 1
empty document honours emptyResult false
equality quotes the column and the value
identifier quoting escapes the delimiter

starts_with and ends_with
in_list and its null-safe negation
sqlCases.expectedSql: ("a"."state_code" IN ('FL', 'TX') AND ("a"."state_code" IS NULL OR "a"."state_code" NOT IN ('NV')))

sqlCases.name: an empty in_list is 1 = 0
field-to-field comparison renders both columns
numeric between

$describeComment: Shared describe() / describeHtml() cases. Both SDKs must produce these strings byte for byte — the HTML ones also pin the escaping, which is the whole safety story for describeHtml.

describeCases.name: empty document
describeCases.expectedHtml: Always

describeCases.name: a single condition
describeCases.expectedHtml: Name is equal to Ben

describeCases.name: field labels are used
describeCases.expectedHtml: Name matches regex ^ben

describeCases.name: choice labels are used, not stored values
describeCases.expectedHtml: State is equal to Florida

describeCases.name: a list of choice values
describeCases.expectedHtml: State is one of Florida, Texas

describeCases.name: a numeric value is unquoted
describeCases.expectedHtml: Score is greater than 10

describeCases.name: a two-value operator
describeCases.expectedHtml: Score is between 5 and 10

describeCases.name: comparing against another field
describeCases.expectedHtml: Email is equal to Billing Email

describeCases.name: two conditions joined by AND
describeCases.expectedText: ([Name] is equal to "A" AND [Name] is equal to "B")
describeCases.expectedHtml: (Name is equal to A AND Name is equal to B)

describeCases.name: a nested OR group
describeCases.expectedText: ([Name] is equal to "A" AND ([State] is equal to "Florida" OR [State] is equal to "Texas"))
describeCases.expectedHtml: (Name is equal to A AND (State is equal to Florida OR State is equal to Texas))

describeCases.name: a negated group
describeCases.expectedText: ([Name] is equal to "A" AND NOT ([State] is equal to "Florida" OR [State] is equal to "Texas"))
describeCases.expectedHtml: (Name is equal to A AND NOT (State is equal to Florida OR State is equal to Texas))

describeCases.name: a negated condition
describeCases.expectedHtml: NOT (Name is equal to A)

describeCases.name: an unknown field falls back to its name
describeCases.expectedHtml: mystery is equal to x

describeCases.name: HTML in a value is escaped
describeCases.expectedHtml: Name is equal to <img src=x onerror=alert(1)>

describeCases.name: HTML in a field label is escaped
describeCases.expectedHtml: <script>bad</script> is equal to x

describeCases.name: quotes and ampersands are escaped
describeCases.expectedHtml: Name is equal to Tom & "Jerry"

describeCases.name: custom emptyText
describeCases.expectedHtml: Everyone

describeCases.name: emptyText is escaped in HTML
describeCases.expectedHtml: <b>all</b>

describeCases.name: contains does not swap a fragment for a choice label
describeCases.expectedHtml: State contains FL

describeCases.name: not_contains does not swap a fragment for a choice label
describeCases.expectedHtml: State does not contain FL

describeCases.name: starts_with does not swap a fragment for a choice label
describeCases.expectedHtml: State starts with FL

describeCases.name: ends_with does not swap a fragment for a choice label
describeCases.expectedHtml: State ends with FL

describeCases.name: regex does not swap a fragment for a choice label
describeCases.expectedHtml: State matches regex FL

describeCases.name: not_regex does not swap a fragment for a choice label
describeCases.expectedHtml: State does not match regex FL

describeCases.name: is one of still uses choice labels — whole values, not fragments
describeCases.expectedHtml: State is one of Florida, Texas

describeCases.name: includes any of lists the chosen labels
describeCases.expectedHtml: Tags includes any of Red, Blue

describeCases.name: includes all of lists the chosen labels
describeCases.expectedHtml: Tags includes all of Red, Green
